_note: Taurus A (Crab Nebula, M1, 3C 144), pulsar wind nebula, at 1420 MHz. Flux density 826 Jy at epoch 2016 from Perley & Butler 2017, ApJS 230, 7 (arXiv:1609.05940), reduced by ~0.25 %/yr to 806 Jy for 2026. Model: elliptical Gaussian 7' x 5', major axis at PA ~125 deg (north through east) = pa_deg -35 in the Interferosim convention. The pulsar (~0.015 Jy at 1.4 GHz) is negligible.
name: tau_a
